g.text: Paired deletion effects: 30 correct grains / 29 recorded section groups
Dots: recorded grain pairs; black: equal-section mean. Thick lines: 95% pointwise section-bootstrap intervals;
thin grey: approximate simultaneous 95% intervals across all 41 contrasts. 10,000 shared paired draws.
*Architecture-specific adaptations. Five implemented methods include structural baselines; no universal ranking.
One selected XAI fold, six classes, fixed mean-fill / segment-fraction protocol; random reference averages three orders.
